title: 60+ saver: withholding at source
answer: The withholding regulations set the rates with no age rule, so the bank withholds the full rate; the assessing officer may allow in writing a reduced withholding where an excess is expected, and otherwise the excess comes back through a return or Form 0135 (TXG-08, TXG-25).

title: FX deposit when the currency falls
answer: The interest is still taxed in full and the loss from negative linkage cannot be offset against it, as the Supreme Court held for a foreign-currency-linked bank deposit in עע"מ 7486/14 (TXI-25; the exchange difference is linkage under TX2-01).
notes: G-24 and compare.server.ts tier2Table (foreign-currency-deposits: "TX2 OQ1, TX2 OQ2"), the TX2 Graduation status ("1 (currency falls)"), fx-and-structured-deposits.md line 319 and coverage.md line 120 still list it as open; TX2-01's conditions still say "(open question 1)" (rule text not edited in Phase A). Caveat: per secondary summaries the Barel facts were a shekel deposit linked to a foreign currency; the extension to an FX-denominated deposit rests on s.1 ("הפרשי שער" count as linkage) and s.125C(a), as TX2-01 already treats both alike; the lead may prefer to keep it narrowed. title: Corporate bonds in default
remains: Income Tax circular 2/2010 settles the holder's side of a court-approved debt settlement (deferral consideration is interest; redemption consideration goes first to accrued interest and discount); when the loss arises if a bond stops paying with no sale or settlement, and how banks withhold and net in a settlement, are open.

title: VAT on portfolio-management fees
answer: 18% VAT on the fee of a manager that is not a financial institution; none on the fees of a bank or a TASE member, which pay wage-and-profit tax instead (TX2-17).
notes: Checked as asked: TX2-17 (2026-10-24, sources re-read 2026-10-25 on the VAT Law, the rate order and the 1977 financial-institution order) answers it at the law level, and coverage.md line 122 records it closed 2026-10-24, but the item was never struck, so method G-24 and compare.server.ts tier2Table (managed-portfolios: "TX2 OQ12, MF-28") still show it as a blocker. The lead should remove TX2 OQ12 from G-24 and the tier2Table (managed portfolios would then be blocked by MF-28 only). The MGD Graduation status already strikes the tax item as closed 2026-10-24.
